notes.title: Update 2.0
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I finally finished remaking Lofi Ping Pong from scratch! It took a lot of late nights after work, so I really hope it's actually better now and that all that effort wasn't wasted.
So, patch notes! ːHorseː


Game design

You can miss 3 times before you lose

You can combine mods (e.g. wind + two balls)

Visuals

Fresh new UI

Technical

Calibration

Key rebinding

5 new languages

Chinese Traditional

Japanese

Korean

Serbian

Vietnamese

Autoplay

Wide screens support

Steam Cloud

Content

Added 2 new tracks from Hamiko

Added “OG” achievement for completing the story without misses

Big shout-out to the awesome folks on our Discord who helped test this version. Thanks to you, it's much more polished than it would have been otherwise.

That said, I'm sure there are still bugs lurking around and plenty of room to improve. So please report anything weird you find, and don't be shy about suggesting new features or changes!

Thanks so much for playing!

notes.title: Lofi Ping Pong on mobiles is out!!!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Finally the game is out on mobile devices! Click on the images to get to the store

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34644940/fbd57d4091fb87ca8481ea0d78252d8d4a8f61bd.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34644940/62b1c1fd9757256088fc1ab6f0e354a75d14237a.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34644940/98e2c6694b9d821ac087c40ab18e382e08cd3ea5.png

What is and what is not in the game

There is:
- free play with a choice of tracks (new ones added)
- story mode (simplified in details)
- completely updated interface (it is more convenient to select tracks, sort by various options)
- more settings (camera movement, turn off the girl's sprite, etc.)
- there are now 4 tries before you lose the game
- you can change the background in the menu c:

No (compared to the Steam version):
- adding your tracks
- track acceleration
- train carriages :c

I do not exclude the possibility that I will add the option to add your own music, I just didn't have an opportunity (time) to do it. I'm interested in doing this myself, so we'll see.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34644940/33a224aa97b9c69849965852b2443f84d377ff2d.png

Steam Update

Also, if you haven't noticed, I have released an update to the PC version of the game. 
First of all, you can now take screenshots (sic!). I was wondering why no one wanted to take one screenshot in a year and a half. It turns out that I simply did not add this option to the game, because I thought that Steam would do everything for me!
New tracks from other artists were also added. Also Portuguese has been added thanks to Thiago "Thitz" Mania.
The following is a list of bugs that you have written during the year:
- Chinese language is now displayed correctly in the story mode
- buttons X, Y, A, B on the gamepad now work in Triple mode
- the second ball could hit earlier than necessary, now it doesn't
- acceleration settings do not go into the storyline from the free play mode (it was decided to leave the no-fail, not a bug, but a feature)
- the end credits could be cut off, this is fixed
- the animal mask in the plot could remain during the gameplay, now it doesn't

What's next

In the near future, I'm going to fix all the bugs that you find in mobile versions, and add new different things that you want (and which are realizable).
I will try to be online as long as possible. To report a bug or just confess your love to the game - join our Discord channel! Or you can also write about whatever you like here on the game page in the Discussions section.

Join our Discord https://discord.com/invite/PGcAZCh

Until next time!

notes.title: Halloween Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Earlier this spring LFPP came out. I made several patches and one major update (Speed increase). Then I said to everyone and myself that I will stop updating LFPP because I got kinda busy with other stuff.
But Ima hooligan and wanna break the rules so here you go - an update. Honestly, I just wanted to distract myself a little bit from a new project that I am making now. I am not planning to patch the game (only if this update will have some bugs) and will continue making new game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34644940/a35b02a2bb59b89791db6c487837b7d83fea4782.png

So, what's new?
New location - attic. It won't appear in Story mode, just in Free play. It has a new gameplay feature - after several hits 3 balls appear on the table, where 2 of them are fake.
Also, 4 new songs are added from our old friends Zmeyev and Satoruu.
You can check new map on the video below.

I hope you like it, it was fun to return to LFPP once again.
[strike]but it was pain to read an old code[/strike]

Also Discord https://discord.gg/R2qbVNx

notes.title: Update Patch #4
notes.content:
You can now change the speed of your songs from 100% to 150%! You can increase it gradually (e.g. from 110 to 120) or set it to persistent (e.g. 130 to 130). This how it will look CLICK (Youtube)
 Norwegian language was added (thanks to shi)
 French language was fixed (thanks to LeDieuOrnithorynque)
 Uploaded OST - CLICK (Youtube)


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34644940/0cc703b175d0a103e727c11aecad7cc7a1ec502c.png

notes.title: Patch #3
notes.content:
Scoring system changes - now you will get more points for faster songs, rather than longer
 Fixed the Wind mode (it is more precise now and the ball changes the direction later)
 Now 3,2,1 is counted in the song's rhythm
 While editing your track you can move the left border not only by 0.05 sec, but by 0.01 sec
 You can now see the score in NoFail mode (NOTE: the score from NoFail still won't go to the Leaderboards)
 Added Simplified Chinese (thanks to Nyko_Saire). A Traditional Chinese should be added later. Note, that I used different Draw system for Chinese and some things may won't work as intended. If you find such things, please write to the Community Hub or to our Discord server


Don't forget that we have a Discord server https://discord.gg/mD6tHDE

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34644940/c917974f98532046c12296c40104676a872228c0.png

notes.title: Patch #2
notes.content:
You can delete songs that you've uploaded by pressing Del
 You can now play with WASD
 If you want to upload a file that's already exists in your playlist, it will upload but the name will be changed to "1/song_name/"
 The central stripe on the table is almost transparent now so it will be easier to hit ball when it flies from center to center
 Added Polish language (thanks to Kiran)


I will now work on Leaderboard system.
Don't forget that we have a Discord server https://discord.gg/mD6tHDE

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34644940/f2055724b4a4a1f362e422baa0b3b0e2609d66c1.png

notes.title: Patch #1
notes.content:
Not that great changes, but still:

 Kinda fixed the grading system (it was always S+)
 Girl didn't move every second hit when playing fast song on Double ball
 When editing track, BPM thresholds were from 50 to 300, now they are from 60 to 250
 Other small fixes, including visuals
